purpose: Phase-0 provenance manifest for the GPL-free X68000 runtime. See PROVENANCE.md. Enforced by CMake from phase 1.

machine_base.note: Last hissorii/px68k commit, identical to the upstream HEAD of https://github.com/hissorii/px68k. No libretro-era contribution.

cpu.terms: Karl Stenerud MIT-style (m68kcpu.c, m68kcpu.h, m68kfpu.c); BSD-style notice (m68kmmu.h)
cpu.native_backend: GenesisRecomp/m68k-recomp-core instruction work, PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 with mstan's non-commercial permission

x68k/.terms: Kenjo WinX68k notice doc/kero_src.txt (non-commercial reuse); modifications by NONAKA Kimihiro (xkeropi) and hissorii

fmgen/.terms: cisc FMGEN readme.txt (freeware, notices, modifications identified, readme unchanged with source)

files.windraw.c: line composition; output target adapted by our build patch
files.keyboard.c: keyboard MCU queue and MFP interrupt; host key table replaced

win32api/ (file shims).note: Keep only what the kept machine files call; anything else goes into our MIT compat layer.

rewrite_mit.machine.c: replaces libretro.c and x11/winx68k.cpp (init, ROM loading, reset, frame loop)
rewrite_mit.input.c: replaces libretro/joystick.c and the libretro key tables
rewrite_mit.media.c: replaces libretro.c disk control and M3U handling
rewrite_mit.state/: replaces libretro/state.c, state.h, state_inline.h and every *_StateAction

forbidden_in_gpl_free_build: any x68k/ or fmgen/ file taken from a revision other than 74ddbb3

post_2020_fixes: b5e2bfa CRTC reset values and 10-bit window masks
9320db7 opcode fetch offsets and IPL from 0xfc0000
b4c1729 DMA start on an active channel restarts it and clears the completion and error flags (written from the public pull request text and MAME's BSD HD63450; tests/test_x68000_dmac.py)
c061408 sprite redraw lines (written from the public pull request text; our own derivation from the line drawing, no libretro code read; tests/test_x68000_sprite_dirty.py)
pre_2020_changes: 90bf5b6 main RAM up to 12 MiB instead of 10 MiB
fd38a31 graphics/BG transparency special mode (backport from Chiorex)
c25b131/96ba6ee frame-rate change detection on CRTC R20
CPU interrupt plumbing for C68K/Cyclone (replaced by cpu_bus.c)

required_notices: NONAKA BSD notices of every kept x11/ and win32api/ file, including the 4-clause acknowledgment
open_points: hissorii's own modifications carry no explicit license; used on the Kenjo lineage's noncommercial terms
opna/psg needed or not by fmg_wrap.cpp without Mercury
